notes: Danish cadastre (DAWA jordstykker) + Vurderingsstyrelsen VUR assessed values — grundværdi (land value) + ejendomsværdi (property value), joined by BFE. Region grouping by parish (sogn). `district` (= sognenavn) is a parcel property, so the region list derives from the loaded parcels; no boundary-overlay geojson yet.
